title: validate-json-schema: support the 'pattern' keyword so substrate contract schemas validate
createdBy: Claude Fable 5 on hulk harness, agent clia
description: First real /capture consumer of validate-json-schema (2026-07-06) hit the loud unsupported-keyword refusal on 'pattern' (axiom.schema.json /slug, and role-workflow-schemas formula/instance). The refusal is correct behavior per the no-silent-fallback axiom, but 'pattern' is a bounded, safe regex keyword used across schema-universal contract schemas. Supporting it (NSRegularExpression or Swift Regex, anchored per JSON Schema semantics) would let /capture Step 3.5 mechanize fully for workflow-formula, workflow-instance, and axiom records instead of falling back to manual required-fields checks.
acceptanceCriteria: 'pattern' keyword validates string instances per JSON Schema draft-2020-12 semantics (unanchored regex search).
CUJ-06 gains a pattern pass + fail test case.
Proof: vaporize validate-json-schema --schema axiom.schema.json --fixture <a conformant axiom> --expect pass exits 0.
Unsupported-keyword refusal behavior unchanged for genuinely unsupported features.
